text.tspan: The classic trap: names only resolve on a user-defined network
No DNS: only IP addresses work.
Every container that didn't pick a network lands here.
Compose creates a user-defined network for you. Isolation: only containers you attach; connect running ones with
docker network connect. In Kubernetes, Services + CoreDNS do this across the whole cluster.
